name: Teeworlds
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The fast 2D multiplayer shooter: deathmatch, team deathmatch, capture the flag and more. Installs any Teeworlds release, and runs on ARM through Box64.
startup: if command -v box64 >/dev/null; then BOX64_LOG=0 exec box64 ./teeworlds_srv; else exec ./teeworlds_srv; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Teeworlds. Downloads the chosen Teeworlds release for Linux from its
# GitHub releases and installs its server. autoexec.cfg (your settings) and
# your own maps in maps/ are never touched; the game's data is replaced
# only once the new download has arrived whole.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=teeworlds/teeworlds
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "${VERSION:-latest}" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "Teeworlds has no release ${VERSION:-latest}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.7.5."
asset="teeworlds-$tag-linux_x86_64.tar.gz"

if [ -x teeworlds_srv ] && [ -d data ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Teeworlds $tag is already installed."
else
    grep -q "^$asset " <<<"$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag")" || fail "Teeworlds $tag has no Linux download. Choose another version."
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build"
    echo "Downloading Teeworlds $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/tw.tar.gz" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$build/tw.tar.gz" -C "$build" || fail "The download was damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    new="$build/teeworlds-$tag-linux_x86_64"
    [ -x "$new/teeworlds_srv" ] || fail "Teeworlds $tag's download has no server in it. Choose another version."
    rm -rf data && mv "$new/data" data
    mv -f "$new/teeworlds_srv" teeworlds_srv
    cp -f "$new/license.txt" license.txt 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f teeworlds
    echo "$tag" > .raptor-version
fi

# Read the server folder first, so maps/ and autoexec.cfg here win over the
# game's own data.
printf 'add_path $CURRENTDIR\nadd_path $DATADIR\n' > storage.cfg
mkdir -p maps
if [ ! -f autoexec.cfg ]; then
    cat > autoexec.cfg <<'CFG'
# Teeworlds server settings. The lines for the name, port, passwords,
# players, map and game type are set from the server's variables at start.
sv_name "A Teeworlds server"
sv_motd ""
sv_port 8303
sv_register 1
sv_max_clients 12
password ""
sv_rcon_password ""
sv_map "dm1"
sv_gametype "dm"
CFG
fi
echo "Installed Teeworlds $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Teeworlds release, such as 0.7.5, or latest for the newest. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: The message players see when they join.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Remote console password
variables.description: The password for the in-game remote console. Empty, the server makes one up at each start and shows it in the console.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to start on, such as dm1, dm2, ctf1 or ctf2, or one of your own in maps/.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: dm (deathmatch), tdm (team deathmatch), ctf (capture the flag), lms (last man standing) or lts (last team standing).

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server in the in-game server browser.
